lines.text: Paul tells Timothy that in the last days terrible times will come.
People in those times will be lovers of themselves and money, and lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God.
Paul says these people have a form of godliness but deny its power, and he tells Timothy to debate them.
They worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women, who are always learning but never come to know the truth.
Like Jannes and Jambres who opposed Aaron, these men oppose the truth, but they will not advance much further.
